sammendrag: Avrupa Birligi ulkelerinde aktif isgucu piyasasi politikalari kapsaminda uygulanan programlarin istihdam sansi ve issizlik suresi uzerine etkilerini incelemek calismanin esas hedefini olusturmaktadir. Aktif programlarinin etkisi, veri kumesini Avrupa Istihdam Stratejisinin ortaya cikisi 1997 yilindan 2013 yilina kadar olan bireysel calismalar uzerinden meta-analiz yontemiyle degerlendirilmektedir. Istihdam ve danismanlik hizmetleri, isgucu egitim programlari ve is ve istihdam yaratma programlarinin istihdam ve issizlik suresi uzerinde etkisini arastiran mikroekonomik degerlendirmelerin ciktilarini sentez ederek etki analizi yapilmistir. Deneysel ve deneysel-olmayan 22 bireysel calismadan AIPP kapsaminda 53 isgucu egitim, is arama ve istihdam hizmetleri, is ve istihdam yaratma programlari icin sabit ve rastgele etki modelleri cercevesinde etki analizi yapilmistir. Degerlendirme sonucunda her 3 program icin calismalar arasi heterojenlik testi kabul edilmistir. Rassal etki modeline gore her uc program icin programa katilim istihdam sansi uzerinde pozitif ancak kucuk etki buyuklugu tespit edilmistir.Abstract The study of the impacts of active labor market policies in European Union on the employment opportunities and unemployment duration is the primary purpose of this thesis. This impact is evaluated based on the individual and independent researches between 1997-2013 after the advent of European Employment Strategy and using Meta-Analysis method. The impacts of job search assistance and employment services, labor market training and job and employment creation programs on employment chance and unemployment duration is analyzed by synthesis of the outcomes of microeconometric evaluations. By using the outcomes of 22 individual researches, 53 active labor market programs were analyzed in three categories: job search assistance and employment services, labor market training and job and employment creation programs. For these analyses two models, namely, fixed effect and random effect were employed. For all three categories the heterogeneity among the researches was verified. For each program random effect model showed positive albeit trivial effect on employment chance.
tittel: AB istihdam stratejisi kapsamında aktif iş gücü piyasası politikaları etkinliği:Meta-analiz yöntemiyle bir değerlendirme
